target.name: Process specific emissions and resources, from uranium milling, at mill plant

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tab. 12 'Direkter Energieverbrauch zur Uranfoerderung und -aufbereitung' (country rows, production-weighted to a world average) together with footnote 42, which states how the thermal and electric demand is booked, and Tab. 13 for the tailings. Per 1 kg of natural uranium.; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

evidence.source: 2012 - LCA electricity generation in Switzerland - Uster.pdf

gaps_reported_by_model: The report gives the direct energy for URANIUM MINING AND MILLING TOGETHER ('Foerderung und -aufbereitung'). This dataset is the milling step alone, so the energy above is an upper bound for it; the excerpt offers no split.
Tab. 12 has no 'world' row - the world average had to be computed from the country rows and the 2009 production volumes.

None of the ~67 elementary flows this dataset actually carries can be read: the report says explicitly 'Anlagen- oder laenderspezifische Angaben zu Emissionsparametern, Landverbrauch, Betriebsmitteln sowie Bedarf an Transporten und Infrastruktur sind ... nicht vorhanden' and falls back on Dones et al. (2009), which is not in this excerpt.
No radioactive emissions to air or water (radon-222, uranium, radium, thorium), which are the dominant flows of a uranium milling dataset.
No chemicals for leaching, no land occupation for the tailings pond, no transport and no infrastructure.
No water use, although the dataset's includedProcesses mentions mining water.
skipped_items: tailings: ignore — Tab. 13, world row: 0.56 m3 of tailings per kg Unat, at a tailings density of 1800 kg/m3 (footnote 46) that is about 1'008 kg of tailings per kg of natural uranium. The dataset's includedProcesses says its land use is 'mostly tailings', but the excerpt gives no area or occupation time, so this quantity cannot be turned into an Occupation or Transformation flow and is reported here rather than invented.

inputs.name: Diesel, burned in diesel-electric generating set
inputs.note: Production-weighted world average computed from the country rows of Tab. 12 with the 2009 production volumes (AU 7424, CA 10174, MW 670, NA 4625, NE 3242, RU 3004, UA 850, BR 345 t Unat; total 30'334 t Unat, matching the TOTAL row of Tab. 13): thermal 417 MJ/kg Unat, electric 59.6 kWh/kg Unat. Footnote 42: 'wird der elektrische Energiebedarf umgerechnet in Dieselverbrauch als "Diesel, burned in diesel-electric generating set" (Wirkungsgrad: 36 %) bilanziert, der Verbrauch an fossilen Energietraegern fuer thermische und Prozessenergie je zur Haelfte als "Heavy fuel oil, burned in industrial furnace 1MW, non-modulating" und "diesel, burned in building machine".' 59.56 kWh x 3.6 MJ/kWh / 0.36 = 595.6 MJ of diesel input. Bounds span the country range (Brazil 7 kWh to Russia 120 kWh per kg Unat).
